question: Through which of the following ways can scientists incorporate desirable characters into crop varieties?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hybridisation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Hybridisation** is the primary method used by scientists to incorporate **desirable characters** into crop varieties by crossing two **genetically dissimilar plants**. ***Hence, statement 4 is correct.***
 
• This process can be categorized into three types based on the level of genetic difference: **Intervarietal** (between different varieties of the same species), **Interspecific** (between two different species of the same genus), and **Intergeneric** (between different genera).
 
• The main objective of this technique is to produce a **hybrid** that combines the best traits of both parents, such as **high yield**, better **nutritional quality**, and resistance to pests.
 
• Another modern way of incorporating traits is through **genetic manipulation**, where a specific **gene** is introduced into the plant's **DNA** to create **Genetically Modified Crops (GM crops)**.
